# Vision9 Solar Inc.

> Vision9 Solar Inc. designs, installs, and maintains residential, commercial, and off-grid solar power systems across Ontario, Canada. We specialize in net metering installations, remote off-grid solar for cottages and luxury properties, and ongoing operations & maintenance for commercial solar sites.

## Contact
- Phone (sales): 613 813 4305
- Email: info@vision9.biz
- Southern Ontario office: Marmora, ON, K0K 2M0
- Northern Ontario office: Kirkland Lake, ON, P2N 3C8
- Service area: Ontario, Canada (Marmora and surrounding areas, Northern Ontario)

## What we do
- Net metering systems for residential and commercial customers in Ontario
- Off-grid remote power systems for contractors, architects, builders, and developers
- Site analysis, inspection, design, and construction of remote solar sites
- Solar site monitoring, operations & maintenance, and ongoing support
- IT consulting, field IT services, network management & security, backup and disaster recovery
